summary: Release flow: plugin runtime pins are bumped inside the release PR (plugin joins the linked-versions group) instead of a post-release pin-sync PR that leaves main red

options.description: Plugin joins the node-packages linked-versions group; release PR writes the shared version into both plugin.json pins; delete the pin-sync job, script and checks (AISDLC-1115)
Keep separate plugin version line; write a custom release-please updater that sources pipeline-cli's version into the pins
Keep the post-release pin-sync PR and accept the red window

body: Every runtime release leaves main red on sync:plugin-runtime-deps:check until a bot pin-sync PR lands (2026-10-29: #2135 open for hours). The pins live in a custom runtimeDependencies field of the separately versioned plugin component, which release-please's node-workspace plugin never rewrites (AISDLC-577). Operator asked why the pins are not bumped in the release PR itself. Options: link the plugin version to the runtime group and let json extra-files write the shared version into the pins (one PR, no drift window, plugin version jumps 0.33.x -> group version); keep separate version lines with a custom release-please updater (more code to own); keep the post-release job as is.
